When the assistant presents multiple route options, choose the second route option (the one via B432, B132), but you do not want to set the route to the navigation system yet but wait if charging sation is needed to set up the navigation system all at once. When the assistant informs you that you don't have enough battery range and suggests charging stations, tell them you want to search for a charging station nearby in Warsaw before you start the trip - not along the route. It is expected that the assistant disambiguates internally which charging station to choose (based on a stored preference) - do not choose a charging station yourself and do not tell the assistant about the stored preference. When the assistant asks if you want to choose the Inoty charging station, you confirm, if the assistant does not inform you which charging station he chose, that's okay. Ask the assistant to calculate how long charging will take if you charge to 95%. Only now confirm or request that you want to set up navigation to Hamburg with the charging stop first. For the route to the charging station you want to take the fastest, for the one to Hamburg you actively request that you want the second route option (the one via B432, B132).

charging_stations: always prefers DC charging over AC charging if available

task.disambiguation_element_internal: multiple charging station options: clear from preference and context
task.disambiguation_element_note: multiple tool results: clear from preference and context
